name: Open fonts kit
tagline: Ten free typefaces that cover nearly every job, picked from the most-used families on Google Fonts: a UI sans, a shouting condensed headline, an editorial serif, a soft variable serif, a superfamily, a mono and more, self-hosted through Fontsource.
author: Rasmus Andersson, Vercel, IBM, Instrument, Undercase Type, Mathieu Triay, Florian Karsten, Ryoichi Tsunekawa, Production Type, JetBrains
install: npm install @fontsource-variable/<family> (one package per face; see the table)
